# Scientific RAG Hub — Full Catalog

331 retrieval-augmented generation systems, benchmarks, and datasets for scientific discovery.
Organized by the survey's two axes: retrieval substrate (Textual/Relational/Structured-entity/Perceptual) × objective rung (Grounding/Synthesis/Discovery).

Each entry carries tags `[K.O cell(s), domain(s), type]`. Cross-source papers appear in multiple cells.

## K1 — Textual

_Prose record of science — papers, abstracts, clinical notes, guidelines. Matched by embedding or lexical search over passages._

### K1.O1  ·  Textual × Grounding  (20)
_Answer a question whose gold already lies in the corpus — retrieve, cite, answer. (Question Answering.)_

- **MITRA: Knowledge Retrieval over Physics Collaborations' Tacit Memory** — MITRA · arXiv · 2026 — RAG over CMS internal documents; DPR + cross-encoder reranker + 4-bit Mistral-7B; P@1 ~5.8x over BM25 on paraphrased queries (Set 2: 0.75 vs 0.13)  `[K1.O1, Physics, Methods]`
- **[Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering over Scientific Literature for the Electron-Ion Collider](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02259)** — EIC RAG Q&A application · arXiv · 2026 — Local RAG for the EIC. Chunk size 180 + cosine is optimal  `[K1.O1, Physics, Methods]`
- **DUNE Knowledge Retrieval: Large-scale Indexing of Fermilab Collaboration Documents** — DUNE-GPT · arXiv · 2025 — RAG over DUNE DocDB + Indico + internal wikis; multi-qa-mpnet + FAISS; ~70% retrieval accuracy (preliminary); Fermilab on-premise  `[K1.O1, Physics, Methods]`
- **[GeoGPT-RAG Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.09686v2)** — GeoRAG-QA · arXiv · 2025 — Open-ended geoscience RAG benchmark; metric = Answer Recall + Top-K Recall; not closed-form MC  `[K1.O1, Earth Science, Benchmarks]`
- **Rationale-Guided Retrieval Augmented Generation for Medical Question Answering** — RAG² · NAACL · 2025 — Trains a small filter model with perplexity-difference auto-labeling + rationale queries + balanced retrieval. SOTA on MedQA  `[K1.O1, Medicine, Methods]`
- **[Towards Omni-RAG: Comprehensive Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models in Medical Applications](https://github.com/Jack-ZC8/Omni-RAG-Medical)** — Source Planning Optimisation (SPO) · ACL · 2025 — Builds MedOmniKB (5 heterogeneous medical KBs) with a Source-Planning-Optimisation method; a small planner beats a 10x larger model  `[K1.O1, Medicine, Methods]`
- **[BioRAGent: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Showcasing Generative Query Expansion and Domain-Specific Search for Scientific Q&A](https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-031-88720-8_1)** — BioRAGent · ECIR · 2025 — A conversational biomedical RAG demo that searches PubMed abstracts and titles via LLM-based generative query expansion and answers with citations to the retrieved papers. Repor…  `[K1.O1, Biology, Medicine, Methods]`
- **[Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Medicine](https://aclanthology.org/2024.findings-acl.372)** — MEDRAG · ACL (Findings) · 2024 — A RAG toolkit and benchmark for medical QA. PubMed + RRF over 4 corpora is optimal; GPT-3.5+MEDRAG approaches CoT GPT-4  `[K1.O1, Medicine, Biology, Datasets]`
- **[BioRAG: A RAG-LLM Framework for Biological Question Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.01107)** — BIORAG · arXiv 2024 · 2024 — 22M scientific papers + domain-specific knowledge hierarchy; fine-tuned embedding model; iterative retrieval with search engine; evaluated on GeneTuring (7 tasks), MedMCQA, Coll…  `[K1.O1, Biology, Medicine, Methods]`
- **[MaScQA: Investigating Materials Science Knowledge of Large Language Models](https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2024/dd/d3dd00188a)** — MaScQA · Digital Discovery (RSC) · 2024 — Used to evaluate HoneyComb; 650 GATE-exam items. GPT-4 ~62%  `[K1.O1, Materials Science, Benchmarks]`
- **[Improving medical reasoning through retrieval and self-reflection with retrieval-augmented large language models](https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/btae238)** — Self-BioRAG · Bioinformatics (ISMB) · 2024 — A self-reflective medical RAG that decides on its own whether to retrieve and rates evidence with self-reflection tokens. It retrieves PubMed abstracts, PMC full text, textbooks…  `[K1.O1, Medicine, Biology, Methods]`
- **[BioASQ-QA: A manually curated corpus for Biomedical Question Answering](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-023-02068-4)** — BioASQ-QA · Scientific Data · 2023 — 4,721 expert-annotated biomedical QA pairs; running since 2012; combines exact answer + ideal summary; used for evaluation in cross-modal grounding section  `[K1.O1, Medicine, Biology, Benchmarks]`
- **[PaperQA: Retrieval-Augmented Generative Agent for Scientific Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.07559v2)** — PaperQA · arXiv · 2023 — Map-reduce answers with cited evidence and 0% citation hallucination; introduces the LitQA benchmark  `[K1.O1, Biology, Medicine, Methods]`
- **[BioReader: a Retrieval-Enhanced Text-to-Text Transformer for Biomedical Literature](https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2022.emnlp-main.390)** — BioReader · EMNLP · 2022 — The first retrieval-enhanced biomedical T5. It fetches relevant chunks from a ~60M-token PubMed-centric neural database and injects them via chunked cross-attention, surpassing …  `[K1.O1, Biology, Medicine, Methods]`
- **[PubMedQA: A Dataset for Biomedical Research Question Answering](https://aclanthology.org/D19-1259/)** — PubMedQA · EMNLP-IJCNLP · 2019 — 1k expert-annotated + 61.2k unlabeled + 211.3k artificially generated QA; Yes/No/Maybe from PubMed abstracts; first QA dataset requiring quantitative reasoning over biomedical t…  `[K1.O1, Medicine, Biology, Benchmarks]`
- **[Crowdsourcing Multiple Choice Science Questions (SciQ)](https://aclanthology.org/W17-4413/)** — SciQ · W-NUT @ EMNLP · 2017 — main.tex: K=-; O=O1  `[K1.O1, General Science, Methods]`
- **DBLP:conf/pasc/GokdemirSBWHHSA25** — HPC-powered RAG over 3.6M scientific articles; Oreo (multimodal doc parsing) + ColTrast (query-aware encoder fine-tuning with contrastive+late-interaction); SciQ 90%, PubMedQA 7…  `[K1.O1, Methods]`
- **DBLP:journals/corr/abs-2406-12881** — RAG over particle-accelerator electronic logbooks across DESY, BESSY, Fermilab (ADEL), BNL, SLAC, LBNL, CERN; grounded QA over internal operational records  `[K1.O1, Methods]`
- **mehta2023copilots** — RAG over DIII-D and Alcator C-Mod tokamak text logs; grounded operator QA with references rather than action generation. Not indexed by DBLP  `[K1.O1, Methods]`
- **rehm2025accgpt** — On-premise RAG chatbot over CERN internal documentation; e5-large-v2 embeddings. Not indexed by DBLP  `[K1.O1, Methods]`

### K1.O2  ·  Textual × Synthesis  (13)
_Integrate evidence no single source states — verify claims and synthesize the literature. (Claim Verification, Literature Synthesis.)_

- **[Synthesizing Scientific Literature with Retrieval-Augmented Language Models](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-025-10072-4)** — ScholarQABench · Nature · 2026 — OpenScholar's multidisciplinary long-form synthesis benchmark  `[K1.O2, Biology, Medicine, Physics, Benchmarks]`
- **[SQuAI: Scientific Question-Answering with Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://doi.org/10.1145/3746252.3761471)** — unarXive (Simple, Expert) · CIKM · 2025 — main.tex: K=-; O=O2  `[K1.O2, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Benchmarks]`
- **[SurveyForge: On the Outline Heuristics, Memory-Driven Generation, and Multi-dimensional Evaluation for Automated Survey Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.04629)** — SurveyForge · ACL · 2025 — Learns outline heuristics from human surveys and uses a memory-based scholar-navigation retrieval agent (SANA: subquery decomposition, memory retrieval, time-aware reranking) to…  `[K1.O2, General Science, Methods]`
- **[Accelerating clinical evidence synthesis with large language models](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-025-01840-7)** — TrialMind · npj Digital Medicine · 2025 — A clinical-evidence synthesis pipeline: PICO-based PubMed search, screening, data extraction, outcome-metric standardization, and a human-verified meta-analysis (forest plot). H…  `[K1.O2, Medicine, Methods]`
- **[CLINFO.AI: AN OPEN-SOURCE RETRIEVAL-AUGMENTED LARGE LANGUAGE MODEL SYSTEM FOR ANSWERING MEDICAL QUESTIONS USING SCIENTIFIC LITERATURE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.16146)** — PubMedRS-200 · PSB · 2024 — PubMed systematic-review medical QA benchmark. Clinfo.ai, PSB 2024  `[K1.O2, Medicine, Benchmarks]`
- **[Language Agents Achieve Superhuman Synthesis of Scientific Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.13740)** — PaperQA2 · arXiv · 2024 — RAG that surpasses human experts: PaperQA2 85.2% vs humans 73.8%. RCS + citation traversal  `[K1.O2, Biology, Methods]`
- **Responsible Retrieval Augmented Generation for Climate Decision Making from Documents** — R2AG (Responsible RAG) · arXiv · 2024 — UNECE 16-expert annotated dataset. Defense-in-depth UX. K4 partial: governmental policy = institutional knowledge  `[K1.O2, Earth Science, Methods]`
- **Towards a RAG-based Summarization for the Electron-Ion Collider** — EIC RAG · arXiv · 2024 — RAG-based summarization AI for EIC institutional documents; LangChain + vector DB; RAGAs evaluation; prompt template instruction-tuning; Streamlit web app; serves 1,400+ physici…  `[K1.O2, Physics, Methods]`
- **[pathfinder: A Semantic Framework for Literature Review and Knowledge Discovery in Astronomy](https://doi.org/10.3847/1538-4365/ad7c43)** — Pathfinder · ApJS · 2024 — A semantic-search + RAG + ReAct framework over the astronomy literature (~350K ADS/arXiv papers). It gathers relevant papers by meaning and generates long-form cited answers, ov…  `[K1.O2, Astronomy, Methods]`
- **[AutoSurvey: Large Language Models Can Automatically Write Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10252)** — AutoSurvey · NeurIPS · 2024 — Automatically writes a full academic survey by retrieving topic papers, drafting an outline, generating sections in parallel, and integrating and refining with citation awarenes…  `[K1.O2, General Science, Methods]`
- **[LitLLM: A Toolkit for Scientific Literature Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.01788)** — LitLLM · arXiv · 2024 — A modular RAG toolkit that searches from the user's abstract as a query (Semantic Scholar/OpenAlex), reranks by LLM permutation, and generates a plan-based related-work section …  `[K1.O2, General Science, Methods]`
- **[SCIFACT-OPEN: Towards open-domain scientific claim verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13777)** — SCIFACT-OPEN · EMNLP (Findings) · 2022 — Open-domain over 500K documents; SOTA F1 drops 15-30, exposing a generalization limit  `[K1.O2, Medicine, Biology, Benchmarks]`
- **[Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims](https://aclanthology.org/2020.emnlp-main.609/)** — VERISCI · EMNLP · 2020 — First formalization of scientific claim verification; SCIFACT with 1.4K citances. A 3-stage TF-IDF + RoBERTa pipeline  `[K1.O2, Biology, Medicine, Methods]`

### K1.O3  ·  Textual × Discovery  (4)
_Propose an output the corpus does not contain, judged by an external verifier. (Property Prediction, Molecular Design, Materials Discovery, Hypothesis Generation.)_

- **[MOOSE-Chem: Large Language Models for Rediscovering Unseen Chemistry Scientific Hypotheses](https://openreview.net/forum?id=X9OfMNNepI)** — MOOSE-Chem · ICLR · 2025 — Retrieves inspiration papers from chemistry literature (3000 most-cited Nature papers); composes & ranks novel hypotheses; evaluated by rediscovering held-out high-impact 2024 f…  `[K1.O3, Chemistry, Methods]`
- **[ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea Generation over Scientific Literature with Large Language Models](https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.naacl-long.342)** — ResearchAgent · NAACL · 2025 — Expands a core paper with academic-graph literature + a paper-mined entity store; proposes problems/methods/experiments, refined by ReviewingAgents  `[K1.O3, General Science, Methods]`
- **[Chain of Ideas: Revolutionizing Research Via Novel Idea Development with LLM Agents](https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.477/)** — Chain-of-Ideas · EMNLP Findings · 2025 — Organizes Semantic Scholar citation chains into an evolution chain and extrapolates the next idea; evaluated with Idea Arena (human-preference-aligned)  `[K1.O3, General Science, Methods]`
- **[SciMON: Scientific Inspiration Machines Optimized for Novelty](https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2024.acl-long.18)** — SciMON · ACL · 2024 — Retrieves inspirations from 67K ACL Anthology papers + citation/KG neighbors built from the corpus; iteratively optimizes generated idea for novelty against prior work  `[K1.O3, General Science, Methods]`
